reviews.title: Excellent Quality
reviews.comment: Purchased these microphones to replace an older system we had at our church.  They were easy to setup and have great range and sound.  I highly recommend.
reviews.author: Adam B

reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.comment: Funcionan muy bien, y duran mucho.
reviews.author: Esteban Hernandez

reviews.title: Quality Preferred Sound
reviews.comment: Usung this in a church sanctuary and the sound is Crystal Clear and no popping or crackling like cheaper microphones. You definitely get what you pay for. Easy first time set up. May want to purchase a cable to plug into the sound board does not come with one.
reviews.author: DnLRobinson

reviews.title: Simplicity is key
reviews.comment: Set up was a breeze. Sound quality is good enough for all but professional touring gigs. Good value
reviews.author: A. Parker
